source.quote_free_summary: A division is defined by age, skill level and Mixed-Role (for example 'ProAm Female Diamond Novice'); Mixed-Role divisions are those where traditional dance-gender roles are not required; a Mixed-Role pair is one follower and one leader of any gender, who must retain their roles throughout each Dance Category.

requirement: A future UCWDC profile must model Mixed-Role as a division dimension and require one leader and one follower of any gender who keep their roles throughout each Dance Category.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: gender collection, columns, migrations, role-lock enforcement, UI.
interpretation_notes: SUFFICIENT today: dance_role per participant (one leader plus one follower is exactly what participantShapeErrors already requires) and no gender needed for the pairing itself. NOT SUFFICIENT: there is no Mixed-Role division axis (studioCustomV3 country_* schemes have skill_level and age_group only); no check that a partnership keeps its roles across entries or across a Dance Category; gender-named divisions (such as the 'Female' in the source's example) have no axis. 'Dance Category' is a UCWDC term whose mapping to DanceFlow dances is not established.
decision_refs: OD-27 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B retain Studio/Custom role flexibility; document body limitations; retrospective audit PR #795)
